    The grading of k(P) by the fundamental group #

    Choose for each object y of a finite ray category P a morphism ℓ y : x₀ ⟶ y of the fundamental groupoid. A nonzero morphism f : y ⟶ z gets the degree ℓ y ≫ [f] ≫ (ℓ z)⁻¹ ∈ Π(P, x₀) (rayDeg); degrees multiply along composites (rayDeg_comp). Grading the ray basis by degree makes k(P) a Π(P, x₀)-graded algebra (rayGrAlg). Graded k(P)-modules are the push-downs of finite-support modules over the universal cover.
